barenaked ladies.bio: Toronto-formed Canadian rock band Barenaked Ladies is known for witty, melodic pop-rock, a catalogue spanning more than three decades and induction into the Canadian Music Hall of Fame.

bass is base.bio: Toronto R&B and hip-hop trio Bass Is Base brought together Chin Injeti, Ivana Santilli and Roger Mooking, blending soul, rap and live musicianship during the 1990s.

bbno$.bio: Vancouver rapper bbno$, born Alexander Gumuchian, is known for playful internet-era hip-hop, viral collaborations and a prolific independent catalogue built around offbeat humour and catchy hooks.

beatchild.bio: Toronto producer, songwriter and multi-instrumentalist Beatchild, also known as Slakah the Beatchild, blends hip-hop, R&B, soul and alternative music across solo work and collaborations.

bibi club.bio: Montréal duo Bibi Club, formed by Adèle Trottier-Rivard and Nicolas Basque, makes minimalist francophone pop shaped by dream-pop, post-punk and experimental influences.

big black lincoln.bio: Toronto R&B and hip-hop group Big Black Lincoln, led by Saukrates with T.R.A.C.K.S., Agile, Ro Dolla and Shakari Nyte, helped shape the city's mid-2000s soul and rap crossover sound.

big sugar.bio: Canadian rock band Big Sugar, led by guitarist and producer Gordie Johnson, blends blues rock, roots music and reggae into a heavy, groove-driven sound.

black atlass.bio: Montréal-born singer, songwriter and producer Black Atlass, born Alexander Fleming, makes dark alternative R&B and has also worked extensively across fashion and visual art.

bobby bazini.bio: Québec singer-songwriter Bobby Bazini, from the Upper Laurentians, blends soul, blues, folk and roots influences with a warm vocal style and guitar-led songwriting.

boslen.bio: Vancouver rapper Boslen, born Corben Bowen, makes cinematic alternative hip-hop that moves between melodic rap, trap and experimental production.

boy golden.bio: Winnipeg singer-songwriter and producer Boy Golden, the project of Liam Duncan, blends folk, country, indie rock and warm analog textures with playful, reflective writing.

bran van 3000.bio: Montréal collective Bran Van 3000 blends hip-hop, electronic music, rock, pop and soul, best known internationally for the late-1990s single Drinking in L.A.

brassmunk.bio: Scarborough hip-hop group Brassmunk combined underground rap, soul and G-funk influences, becoming an important part of Toronto's late-1990s and 2000s hip-hop scene.

bruno pelletier.bio: Québec singer Bruno Pelletier is a major francophone pop and musical-theatre performer whose career includes multiple Félix awards, platinum-selling albums and prominent stage roles.

belly.bio: Palestinian-Canadian rapper, singer, songwriter and producer Belly was raised in Ottawa and became known for solo hip-hop releases as well as songwriting collaborations with The Weeknd and other major artists.

bishop brigante.bio: Toronto rapper and battle-rap pioneer Bishop Brigante, born Nickolas Parra, was a longtime recording artist and key figure in Canada's battle-rap community before his death in 2025.

birthday boy.bio: Toronto producer, DJ and musician Birthday Boy, born Eoin, blends hip-hop, dance and R&B influences with a sample-minded production style shaped by the city's club and rap culture.
